subject: Global demo planning: regional session options + holiday constraints
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chan <sophia.chan@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Global demo planning: regional session options + holiday constraints

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the time last week. We want to lock a global walkthrough/demo for the platform + mutual action plan and make sure we accommodate the many regional stakeholders (US, EU, APAC). A couple constraints we've seen across customers: DST changes in March, EU bank holidays around Easter, and APAC teams that prefer avoiding Golden Week windows — plus Diwali can block some India-based stakeholders later in the year.

High-level ask: do you have a 1-week window in late March / early April when most stakeholders are available? To make planning easier I propose two options:

- Option A: Two shorter regional sessions (90 min each):
  - APAC/EU overlap session (preferred for product/engineering leads)
  - US-focused session later the same week for PMs and execs
- Option B: One consolidated 2-hour session timed at an overlap that is tolerable for all (we'll keep it demo + 15m Q&A)

Notes: US DST begins 14 Mar 2027 (so PT shifts from UTC-8 to UTC-7) which affects the UTC offsets for any March times; EU countries will observe the Easter bank holiday (varies by country, late March/early April) and Japan has Golden Week in early May (important for follow-ups).

Proposed initial dates to check availability (local-time conversions left simple to avoid confusion):
- Week of Mar 21–25, 2027 (pre-Easter; more likely EU coverage)
- Week of Apr 4–8, 2027 (post-Easter; avoids the immediate bank holidays)

Attached: initial MAP + stakeholder table (global-demo-MAP_v2.xlsx) — I marked who we think needs to attend live vs. recorded.

Can you confirm rough availability for ZephyrAI stakeholders and any hard OOO windows (Diwali, Golden Week, year-end quiet periods)? If those two weeks work, we can propose concrete times with DST-aware conversions.

Thanks —
Aditya
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan stub)

From: Sophia Chan <sophia.chan@zephyrai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 10:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Global demo planning: regional session options + holiday constraints

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick notes from our side after checking with stakeholders in London, Milan and Tokyo:

- EU: several members of our London & Milan teams are planning to take time around Easter week (Fri 26 Mar -> Tue 30 Mar for most). That makes the week of Mar 21 still possible, but the latter part of the week is shaky.
- APAC: Tokyo product team will be mostly unavailable during first week of May (Golden Week) — that's mostly relevant for follow-ups / in-person planning in Japan.
- India: our R&D lead in Bangalore noted Diwali will be a hard block (late Oct / early Nov) for any workshops later in the year — good to capture now for roadmap planning.
- DST note: we also track the US DST change in March; for global scheduling it's helpful if you send times in UTC + one local conversion so we don't accidentally double-convert.

Given the above, our preference is:
1) Avoid the week containing Easter bank holidays for EU (so shifting to week of Apr 4–8 looks safer for EU and APAC follow-ups)
2) If you go with two regional sessions, we prefer the APAC/EU session on Apr 5 (morning JST / late evening ET) and US session on Apr 6 (mid-afternoon ET / late night CET) — happy to give concrete HH:MM slots once you propose UTC times.

One more data point: Luca (copilot for the procurement track) will be OOO Mar 28–29 (personal travel) so best to avoid that single-day overlap.

I'll loop in our internal calendar manager if we lock dates.

Best,
Sophia
Director, Partnerships — ZephyrAI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chan <sophia.chan@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Global demo planning: regional session options + holiday constraints

Thanks for the quick check, Sophia — that lines up with what we were seeing.

Plan: let's avoid the Easter week and propose two short sessions in the week of Apr 4–8. Suggested concrete slots (all listed in UTC first; I've included US PT / CET / JST as approximate conversions to avoid DST confusion):

- APAC/EU session: Apr 5, 2027 08:00 UTC (Apr 5 — 01:00 PT / 09:00 CET / 17:00 JST) — 75 minutes
- US session: Apr 6, 2027 21:00 UTC (Apr 6 — 14:00 PT / 22:00 CET / Apr 7 06:00 JST) — 75 minutes

Rationale: two shorter sessions reduce cognitive load for cross-region participants and mean we can tailor demos/examples for local use-cases. We'll record both and share the recording & short executive highlights for folks who cannot join.

Attachments: updated MAP (global-demo-MAP_v2.xlsx) with attendee asks and a proposed run of show (we're keeping both sessions tightly scripted).

Can you confirm: 1) APAC/EU session on Apr 5 and 2) US session on Apr 6 as proposed? If those work, we'll send calendar invites (with the UTC times as primary) and include a 'preferred timezone' field so invites respect DST settings.

Thanks —
Aditya
Attachment: global-demo-MAP_v2.xlsx

On Mon, 20 Dec 2026 at 15:12 -0800, Aditya Rao wrote:
> Can you confirm: 1) APAC/EU session on Apr 5 and 2) US session on Apr 6 as proposed?

Confirming from our side — both slots are tentatively good. We'll wait for ZephyrAI to confirm formal acceptance, then we'll send invites and include calendar notes about DST and the related holiday constraints (Easter bank holidays, Golden Week for Japan, Diwali for India later in the year).

Two small asks before invites go out:
- Please provide a single UTC timestamp in the invite body (we will not do further conversions).
- Add a short line in the invite: "If you prefer a recording, please indicate in RSVP" so people who are OOO (e.g., Luca on Mar 28–29) aren't expected to attend live.

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
